core_rule: Certain serving high officials may enjoy immunity ratione personae before foreign national courts.
risk: Premature indictment may fail or create diplomatic dispute.
lawyer_task: Separate current office-holder status from former-official or functional immunity questions.

core_rule: Official-act immunity is contested for international crimes in domestic courts.
lawyer_task: Analyze forum precedent, treaty exceptions, and ICJ/ILC materials.

core_rule: Forum proceedings may depend on extradition, arrest, or transfer.
risk: Political offence exceptions, human rights bars, or dual criminality problems.
lawyer_task: Map extradition treaty terms and non-refoulement constraints.

core_rule: Some treaties require prosecution or extradition when conditions are met.
risk: Obligation may be treaty-specific rather than universal.
lawyer_task: Identify the precise treaty basis and triggering facts.
